description.value: Eden Grove is an unprotected, 30-hectare ancient lowland forest in the Gordon River Valley within Pacheedaht First Nation territory, roughly 45 minutes from Port Renfrew. The grove contains towering old-growth western redcedars and Douglas-firs — some exceeding 13 feet in diameter — and a short trail with boardwalk sections winds through the forest. It sits adjacent to Big Lonely Doug, Canada's second largest Douglas-fir, making it a striking destination for cyclists exploring the Port Renfrew area.
